caption:
Amazon and Meta talk about lifting the block on Meta's Muse shopping agent

Amazon and Meta are in talks to bring back Muse, Meta's AI shopping agent that Amazon kicked off its platform in September. The two sides are stuck on ad revenue and who controls search results. Amazon's ad business generates $68.6 billion a year, and Muse commands 51 percent of all agentic shopping orders.

Reported by The Decoder; TechCrunch; The Verge.
